model.name: SAP Enterprise Repository
model.documentation: Author: Bram-Jan Duits; Generated: 2026-08-13. Full SAP Enterprise Architecture repository for RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, structured per the TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM), covering Strategy, Business, Application, Technology, Motivation and Implementation & Migration layers, including current/target plateaus and a capability heatmap.
